title: Written Communication Coach
subtitle: Short reminders. One action today. Write it so everyone sees the same picture.

reminders.headline: One week, one outcome
reminders.reminder: Tasks are not the story. Name the outcome, then the work.
reminders.action: Write three lines: this week’s outcome, the work that feeds it, what “done” looks like. Put it where the team already looks.
reminders.metric: Cycle time on the work you named. If it grew, the week was busy, not aligned.
reminders.upgrade: End Friday with “we shipped X” or “we did not, because Y.” That is your accountability loop.

reminders.headline: Same risk, every team
reminders.reminder: Cross-team work dies in private chats. Make the risk visible before it becomes a fire.
reminders.action: One written note: the goal, two teams who must move, the risk if they do not, the owner. Send it before standup.
reminders.metric: Change failure rate on the shared path to production. If it rises, you aligned on speed, not on a safe release.
reminders.upgrade: When two teams disagree, write 2 constraints, 3 options, 1 recommendation. Do not host a debate with no write-up.

reminders.headline: Why before the work
reminders.reminder: Strategy is a tradeoff people can repeat. If they cannot say the “why,” they will invent one.
reminders.action: Write Headline → Context → Action → Result for this quarter’s bet. One page. Share it with product and your EMs.
reminders.metric: Activation and the North Star. Delivery that does not move those is the wrong bet.
reminders.upgrade: Name what you will not do this quarter. Feature flags let you ship a small bet without a big-bang launch.

reminders.formula: Hypothesis → Metrics → Small bet → Instrument → Decide
reminders.headline: Portfolio on one page
reminders.reminder: Multi-quarter work needs one list of bets, owners, and what you starve. People cannot guess the allocation.
reminders.action: Write four rows: bet, owner, this quarter’s proof, what you paused to fund it. Send it to EMs and the VP.
reminders.metric: Retention plus deployment frequency. Fast deploys on a shrinking North Star means the portfolio is wrong.
reminders.upgrade: On the largest unclear bet: hypothesis, metric, small bet, instrument, decide. Tests and flags beat a six-month plan.

reminders.formula: Goals → Written updates → Weekly rhythm → Risk reviews → Accountability
reminders.headline: One picture for the company
reminders.reminder: Vision is useless if orgs still optimize local goals. Write the company picture, then the org shape that serves it.
reminders.action: Send a short note to execs and directors: the outcome that matters, how teams are shaped to deliver it, the one risk you want named in every weekly update.
reminders.metric: MTTR and retention together. Slow restore plus falling users is a trust problem, not a tooling story.
reminders.upgrade: Lock the five loops in writing. Ask directors to run them. AI coding tools and observability only scale if this picture is shared.
